prayerExcerpt.en-US: God has always raised up holy pastors zealous to maintain the faith of His Church inviolable.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Deus sempre suscitou santos pastores zelosos por manter inviolável a fé de sua Igreja.

meta.face: A Roman of about seventy-five with a weathered olive complexion and a BROAD, FLAT-FEATURED face under a ROUND, bald crown with white hair at the sides — a wide, LOW, slightly bulging brow, TUFTED white brows that FLARE UP at their outer ends, SMALL, kind, DOWN-SLANTING grey eyes, a BROAD, FLAT nose with a LOW bridge, wide, flat cheeks, a small mouth; a long, full, WAVY white beard falling to the chest with a white moustache, as in the book's engraving; the gaze grave and gentle, toward us. Not the wide, fringed, square-bearded callistus (his deacon), the round, dark-bearded Pontian of pontian_hippolytus, the heart-shaped soter, or the long-faced fabian and stephen_i.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book's engraving gives him a long white beard; the flat, broad features are ours, to keep him apart from the other early popes. Dress without tiara or mitre, as on stephen_i.
